extracted.name: Vodka cucumber lemonade
extracted.description: Make your own lemonade to lift the flavour of this vodka and cucumber cocktail, though you can use shop-bought to make the recipe even quicker and easier
ingredient_lines: 6 large unwaxed lemons juiced, plus extra lemon slices to serve
2 organic medium cucumbers chopped into cubes
instruction_lines: Mix the sugar with 180ml hot water in a heatproof bowl until the sugar has dissolved. Leave to cool completely. Stir in the lemon juice.

Tip the cucumbers into a blender with a splash of water and blitz until liquified. Tip some ice, the vodka, the lemonade from step 1 and the puréed cucumbers (see tip, below) into a large pitcher and stir well.
Top up the pitcher with soda water and stir well again, then drop in a few lemon slices just before serving.
